caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate with a decorative pattern. The plate is shown from a top-down perspective and occupies a central position on a plain, light beige background. The main design of the plate consists of an eight-pointed star in dark green with some dots and textures contained within the points, set against a pale yellow background. The star has pointed extensions, with alternating segments within each point displaying a variation of green patterning. Surrounding the star, there is a decorative border composed of semi-circular shapes in brownish-orange and green, with a wavy dark green design connecting them along the inside edge of the rim. The overall color palette includes earthy tones such as green, brown, orange, and yellow. Near the bottom right edge of the plate, on the background, there is a small handwritten signature: "E. M. Schelling." The background is empty apart from these details, giving prominence to the central plate illustration.
title: Pa. German Small Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
